bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
gate="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$gate"
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service
loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value
test -S deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock && stat -c 'RESIDENT_SOCKET_MODE=%a' deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock || echo RESIDENT_SOCKET_NOT_AVAILABLE
echo CLIENT_ACTIONS
sed -n '1,95p' scripts/userbot_test_client.py
echo RESIDENT_ACTION_DISPATCH
sed -n '1,85p' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
sed -n '450,515p' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
sed -n '515,620p' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
